title: Integrations
intro: Where approved Submissions go. Attach an Integration to the Forms it should receive.
emptyDescription: Without one, approving a Submission just marks it approved. Add your system's endpoint to have Vink send the data there.
deleteDescription: It is detached from its Forms, and nothing is sent to it anymore.
deleteSubscriptionDescription: An automation platform made it with the API Key {key}. Deleting it ends that Subscription: the platform gets nothing anymore.
signingSecretText: Every request carries an X-Vink-Signature header, {format}: HMAC-SHA256 of {signed} with this secret. Refuse a request whose t is more than 5 minutes old.
notAttached: Not attached to any Form yet.
lockedNote: An attached Form's keys are locked. Submissions approved before attaching aren't sent.
googleConnected: Connected. Vink made the sheet in your Google Drive.
googleNoAccess: Vink didn't get access to make the sheet. Connect again and tick the box for Google Drive.
googleFailed: Connecting Google didn't work. Try again.
googleReconnected: Reconnected. Re-send the failed Deliveries to add their rows.
googleNoSheetAccess: That Google account can't reach the sheet. Reconnect with the account that made it.
needsReconnectText: Google no longer lets Vink write to the sheet. Reconnect with the Google account that made it, then re-send the failed Deliveries.
excelConnected: Connected. Vink made the workbook in your OneDrive.
excelNoAccess: Vink didn't get access to your files, so it couldn't make the workbook. Connect again and accept.
excelDenied: Microsoft wasn't connected. If it asked for admin approval, your IT admin has to approve Vink first. See "Does your company need IT admin approval?" under New Integration, Excel.
excelFailed: Connecting Microsoft didn't work. Try again.
excelReconnected: Reconnected. Re-send the failed Deliveries to add their rows.
excelNoSheetAccess: That Microsoft account can't reach the workbook. Reconnect with the account that made it.
needsReconnectTextExcel: Microsoft no longer lets Vink write to the workbook. Reconnect with the Microsoft account that made it, then re-send the failed Deliveries.
adminConsentTitle: Your IT admin needs to approve Vink first
adminConsentText: Your company lets only its IT admin give apps access to Microsoft 365. Send them this link. They sign in, check what Vink asks for, and approve it once for the whole company. Then connect again.

dialog.description: Vink POSTs each approved Submission's Payload here as JSON, signed with this Integration's own secret.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.headersHint: For an API key, Bearer or Basic auth. Secret values are stored encrypted.
dialog.sheetsDescription: Vink adds a row per line of each approved Submission to a new sheet in your Google Drive.
dialog.sheetNameHint: Also the name of the sheet Vink makes.
dialog.connectSignIn: You sign in with Google on its own page, then come back here.
dialog.connectAccess: Vink can only open the sheet it makes, none of your other files.
dialog.connectRows: Columns are the Form's Field keys. A new Field gets a new column just before Vink's three columns on the right.
dialog.reconnectHint: Signs in with Google again. The sheet stays the same, so use the Google account that made it.
dialog.excelDescription: Vink adds a row per line of each approved Submission to a table in a new workbook in your OneDrive.
dialog.excelConnectSignIn: You sign in with your Microsoft 365 work account on Microsoft's page, then come back here. Personal Microsoft accounts can't be used.
dialog.excelConnectAccess: Vink asks to read and write your OneDrive files. It only opens the workbook it makes.
dialog.excelNameHint: Also the name of the workbook Vink makes.
dialog.excelReconnectHint: Signs in with Microsoft again. The workbook stays the same, so use the Microsoft account that made it.
dialog.adminTitle: Does your company need IT admin approval?
dialog.adminText: Many companies let only their IT admin approve apps for Microsoft 365. Microsoft then says "Need admin approval" when you sign in. Send your IT admin this link. They sign in as a Cloud Application Administrator or Application Administrator and approve Vink once for the whole company. In the Microsoft Entra admin center this is Enterprise apps, Vink, Permissions, Grant admin consent.
dialog.adminLinkMissing: Excel isn't set up here yet, so there is no link.

test.title: Send a test
test.description: Posts a signed envelope marked "test": true, so your receiver can check the format. It isn't a Delivery.
test.dataHint: Dummy data, or an Approved Submission of this Form. Submissions still in review are never sent.
test.sheetsDescription: Adds rows from this data to the sheet, with [test] before the filename. It isn't a Delivery.
test.excelDescription: Adds rows from this data to the workbook, with [test] before the filename. It isn't a Delivery.
